tool_args.command:
cat << 'PYEOF' | python3
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Okabe-Ito colors
C_BLUE   = '#0072B2'
C_GREEN  = '#009E73'
C_ORANGE = '#D55E00'

fractions = [0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 1.00]
probe_gru      = [0.805, 0.820, 0.872, 0.906]
structural_rf  = [0.991, 0.992, 0.995, 0.995]
structural_gb  = [0.987, 0.993, 0.995, 0.995]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.25, 2.6))

ax.plot(fractions, structural_rf, '-o', color=C_BLUE, markersize=5,
        label='Structural RF', zorder=3)
ax.plot(fractions, structural_gb, '-s', color=C_GREEN, markersize=5,
        label='Structural GB', zorder=3)
ax.plot(fractions, probe_gru, '--^', color=C_ORANGE, markersize=5,
        label='ProgressProbe (GRU)', zorder=3)

# Annotate data points
offset_map = {
    'rf':  [(0, -0.012), (0, -0.012), (0, -0.012), (0.02, -0.012)],
    'gb':  [(0, 0.006),  (0, 0.006),  (0, 0.006),  (-0.02, 0.006)],
    'gru': [(0, 0.006),  (0, 0.006),  (0, 0.006),  (0, 0.006)],
}

for x, y, (dx, dy) in zip(fractions, structural_rf, offset_map['rf']):
    ax.annotate(f'{y:.3f}', (x, y), textcoords='data',
                xytext=(x + dx, y + dy), fontsize=7, ha='center', va='top', color=C_BLUE)

for x, y, (dx, dy) in zip(fractions, structural_gb, offset_map['gb']):
    ax.annotate(f'{y:.3f}', (x, y), textcoords='data',
                xytext=(x + dx, y + dy), fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom', color=C_GREEN)

for x, y, (dx, dy) in zip(fractions, probe_gru, offset_map['gru']):
    ax.annotate(f'{y:.3f}', (x, y), textcoords='data',
                xytext=(x + dx, y + dy), fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom', color=C_ORANGE)

ax.set_xlabel('Training data fraction')
ax.set_ylabel('Macro-F1')
ax.set_ylim(0.75, 1.005)
ax.set_xticks(fractions)
ax.set_xticklabels(['0.10', '0.25', '0.50', '1.00'])

ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, color='#cccccc', zorder=0)
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.9)

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/agent_progress_probe/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_data_scaling.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
fig.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig_data_scaling.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Done')
PYEOF
